_about: The team report's text library (DECISIONS 307): per rule, merge group and Note-card topic a title, finding, explanation, why it matters, steps (with platform variants), verification and summary; the page-1 templates. No digits: numbers come from report.json. Read by maya_audit_web/team_report/texts.py.

page1.band_high: There are blocking or high-severity issues
page1.headline: {band}; start with {focus}.
page1.headline_none: No issues recorded; review the notes and the confirm-first list.
page1.headline_unread: The site's content could not be read; the report needs a new audit.
page1.assessment_none: There is no issue card; review the notes and the confirm-first list by hand.
page1.tail_confirm: plan the confirm-first list once it is checked in a browser.
page1.tail_plain: audit the site again after the fixes.
page1.priority_confirmed: The owner's manual check confirmed the finding.
page1.priority_estimated: The measurement is an estimate; confirm it on an example page first.
page1.priority_perf_text: Check the metrics Lighthouse shows past their threshold with a similar local test.
page1.next_text: {explanation} Then move on to these cards: {rest}.
page1.next_text_alone: {explanation} Audit the site again after the fix.
page1.next_none: There is no issue card; review the notes.
page1.caveat_reanalysis: The numbers were rebuilt from the saved audit; no new crawl was made.
page1.caveat_measured: The findings are one audit's measurement; audit again after the fixes.
page1.caveat_estimated: The first finding is an estimate; confirm it on an example page before fixing.
page1.caveat_confirm: The confirm-first list was not checked in a browser.

html_weight.explanation: Move inlined JSON, scripts and styles out of the HTML and let the main content start early in it.
html_weight.why: In heavy HTML, crawlers and AI tools reach the main content late or may stop reading before it.
steps: Move inlined JSON, CSS and scripts into separate files
Remove unused blocks and templates from the theme
If the theme is restricted, raise it with the platform
html_weight.verify: In the page source, the main content starts near the top and the page HTML is smaller.

empty_pages.explanation: Find why the page answers empty in the server or CDN logs and make it answer with its content.
empty_pages.why: Search engines and AI crawlers cannot read a page that answers empty; it may drop out of the index.
steps: Look up the empty addresses in the server and CDN logs
Find the rule that serves automated clients an empty page
Make the page answer every client with its content
empty_pages.verify: Search Console › URL Inspection › Live test shows the page with its content.

heading_levels.explanation: Use heading levels in order and fix the heading levels of repeated blocks in the theme.
heading_levels.why: Headings in order tell search engines and screen readers how the page is structured.
steps: Find the skipped heading levels
Use headings in order: a subheading follows its parent level
Fix the headings of repeated blocks in the theme
heading_levels.verify: Headings go down one level at a time, with no level skipped.

links_without_text.explanation: Give links with no text a visible name, or give their images an alt text.
links_without_text.why: Neither a crawler nor a screen reader can tell where a link with no name leads.
steps: Add visible text or an aria-label to the link
If it wraps an image, give the image alt text
In repeated blocks, do it in the theme

links_without_address.explanation: Give elements that lead to a page a real address, and use a button for elements that only act.
links_without_address.why: Crawlers cannot follow a link with no address, so the page it leads to may never be found.
steps: Find the links with no address in the theme
Give the ones that lead to a page a real href
Turn elements that only act into buttons
links_without_address.verify: Every element that leads to a page carries an address a crawler can follow.

language_mismatch.explanation: Translate the menu, titles and text left in the other language, or fix the page language.
language_mismatch.why: When the declared language and the content differ, engines may show the page for the wrong language.
steps: List the regions left in the other language
Translate the menu, titles and text for this language
Set the page language to the language of its content
language_mismatch.verify: A page's main content is in the language its address and markup declare.

sitemap_lastmod.explanation: Take the sitemap lastmod dates from each page's real last edit.
sitemap_lastmod.why: Lastmod dates that are not real make it harder for engines to tell which pages changed.
steps: Take lastmod from each page's real last edit
If the real date is not available, leave lastmod out
Find the processes that save everything at once
sitemap_lastmod.verify: Each address's lastmod is the date its page last changed.

template_meta.explanation: Stop the template writing one title and description on every page; give each page its own.
template_meta.why: One title and description on many pages does not tell an engine, or a reader, which page to choose.
steps: List the pages that share one description
Write each its own meta description
List the pages that share one <title>
template_meta.verify: Every page meant to be found has a title and description of its own.

WebSite.step: Add WebSite structured data to the homepage: name and url

FAQPage.step: Add FAQPage data matching the questions and answers shown on the page

BreadcrumbList.step: Mark up the visible breadcrumb trail with BreadcrumbList

Product.step: Add Product data with name, price and availability to product pages

Product + Offer.step: Add Product and Offer data to pricing pages

Article.step: Add Article data with headline, author and date to article pages

Organization.step: Complete the Organization data: add logo and sameAs

_schema_other.step: Add the structured data type the page type expects

llms.txt links that redirect.step: Replace redirecting links in llms.txt with their final address

internal links to redirecting addresses.step: Point internal links at the final address, not the redirect

no twitter:card.step: Add a twitter:card tag to pages with Open Graph tags

og:url differs from canonical.step: Make og:url the same address as the canonical

empty <meta> tags.step: Remove or fill the empty <meta> tags

parameters on links to other sites.step: Remove tracking and member-view parameters from outbound links

menu labels in another language.step: Translate menu and footer labels into the page's language

questions not marked as headings.step: Mark the questions of the question-and-answer block as headings

address words that look misspelled.step: Confirm the address spelling; if it changes, redirect the old address permanently

HTML not cached at the CDN.step: Review with the platform whether the page HTML can be cached at the CDN

platform.Shopify: On Shopify the HTML cache is managed by the platform; change nothing without a theme setting

images without width and height.step: Give images a width and a height

image preload with type=\"image/jpg\".step: Set the type of preloaded images to image/jpeg

no WebP or AVIF images.step: Serve images in WebP or AVIF as well

VideoObject with default values.step: Fill VideoObject with the real video's name, description and image
